name: Ca dia
summary: A brackish fish Thanh Niên, 14 March 2016, lists at chợ Cầu Hai, caught in phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai. No recipe is printed. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Chợ Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên lists cá dìa with the other lagoon fish.
howToEat: Buy it at the market. Thanh Niên says people buy the fish to cook, often for the weekend, and does not name a grill or a soup.
A price is Check on arrival. A market hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Cầu Hai, on National Highway 1A, about 40 km south of Huế, facing the lagoon. Thanh Niên does not name a stall.
seoTitle: Ca dia at Cau Hai market
seoDescription: Cá dìa is a lagoon fish at chợ Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên lists it and prints no recipe. A price is Check on arrival.
